race.comment: ZOUBOY (3) is the one to beat after making it two wins from two starts with a strong first-up Class 1 success at this track, where he beat Sun To Me by a length and a half and again showed he handles soft ground. The 1.5kg claim helps offset the impost and his unbeaten local profile gives him the clearest winning case. Hard to stop in this vein of form. HIDDEN STAR (6) is the main danger, with her first-up 900m fifth looking a useful pipe-opener for a return to 1250m, where she has two wins and one placing from three starts at this track and distance. Proven second up and saves her best for this track. SHUDA KNOWN (7) is better judged on the Kembla Grange Class 1 win than the Randwick ninth, given he raced wide and lost a plate. Maps well and can bounce back quickly. COYOTE (10) surprised at the good odds first up when he gripped on to run second at Gosford in Class 1 grade. Will keep improving as he gets out in trip.
